user.title: Connect to Veyra
user.description: Enter only the Veyra IP/hostname and web port. Cameras, MQTT topics and model classes are discovered automatically.

abort.already_configured: This Veyra instance is already configured.

init.title: Veyra notifications
init.description: Select Home Assistant Companion devices. Every Veyra new/update event is forwarded immediately. When one camera generates a burst of alerts, Veyra keeps alerting normally but adds a temporary mute button to subsequent notifications from that camera.

data.flood_mute_enabled: Show mute button after a notification burst
data.flood_mute_threshold: Notifications before showing the mute button

data_description.flood_mute_enabled: No separate prompt is sent. The phone keeps sounding/vibrating; after the threshold, the mute button appears on normal alerts from that camera.
data_description.flood_mute_threshold: Default 12. After this many pushes from one camera within the selected window, subsequent alerts get a mute button.
data_description.flood_mute_duration_minutes: Notifications for the muted camera automatically resume after this time.
